subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the four exact-pin assertions are repaired and exact-head checks pass, should this grouped batch of privileged GitHub Action revisions be approved?
rationale: The assertion changes are mechanical, but accepting new third-party executable revisions in credentialed publishing, agent, and security-scanning workflows requires designated owner judgment.

options.title: Repair and approve batch
options.body: Update the four guard assertions, validate the exact head, and approve the grouped revisions after security-owner review.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token, registry, CodeQL, and Codex action updates into narrower independently reviewed pull requests.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve batch
recommendation.body: Update the four guard assertions, validate the exact head, and approve the grouped revisions after security-owner review.
